program:
app "Intervals" bolt ink
setting work dur = 40s
setting rest dur = 20s
state left dur = 40s
state going bool = no
state working bool = yes
state rounds num = 0
every 1s if going set left = left - 1s
when going and left <= 0s set rounds = rounds + if(working, 0, 1) then set left = if(working, rest, work) then set working = not working
stack align center card pad 3 fill if(working, accent, good)
  if(working, "WORK", "REST") head
  left big
  "Round" rounds + 1 faint
row gap 1
  button if(going, "Pause", "Start") tap set going = not going
  button "Reset" tap set going = no then set left = work then set working = yes then set rounds = 0
describe:
Intervals, in the ink colours.
You can change: work: length of time, starts at 40 seconds; rest: length of time, starts at 20 seconds.
Remembers while you use it: left, starting at 40 seconds; going, starting at no; working, starting at yes; rounds, starting at 0.
Shows:
- every 1 seconds while going, it sets left to left minus 1 seconds.
- when going and left is at most 0 hours, it sets rounds to rounds plus 0 when working, otherwise 1, then sets left to rest when working, otherwise work, then sets working to not working.
- text: "WORK" when working, otherwise "REST".
- text: left.
- text: "Round", rounds plus 1.
- a button "Pause" when going, otherwise "Start"; a tap sets going to not going.
- a button "Reset"; a tap sets going to no, then sets left to work, then sets working to yes, then sets rounds to 0.

fuller_style: chatty with a reason why the person needs it, 22 to 38 words

app "Tiles" grid slate
state fl num = 4
state fw num = 3
state ts num = 60
field fl "Floor length (m)"
field fw "Floor width (m)"
field ts "Tile side (cm)"
let n = fl * fw * 10000 / max(ts * ts, 1) * 1.1
let up = if(n = floor(n), n, floor(n) + 1)
"Tiles with 10% spare" up big
"Floor" fl * fw "sq m" faint
describe:
Tiles, in the slate colours.
Works out:
- n is fl times fw times 10000 divided by the larger of ts times ts and 1 times 1.1.
- up is n when n is n rounded down, otherwise n rounded down plus 1.
Remembers while you use it: fl, starting at 4; fw, starting at 3; ts, starting at 60.
Shows:
- a box to fill in fl, labelled "Floor length (m)".

- a box to fill in ts, labelled "Tile side (cm)".
- text: "Tiles with 10% spare", up.

program:
app "Workouts" dumbbell plum
table workout kind pick Run|Gym|Yoga|Walk = Run
state m date = today
monthnav m
grid 7 gap 1
  each ["M", "T", "W", "T", "F", "S", "S"] as w
    w tiny color muted align center
  each 1..weekday(m - monthday(m) + 1) - 1
    box
  each days month of m as d
    stack height 44 radius 6 pad 1 fill soft
      monthday(d) tiny
      row gap 0
        each workout on d
          draw width 10
            circle 50, 50, 40 fill if(it.kind = Run, accent, if(it.kind = Gym, good, if(it.kind = Yoga, warn, bad)))
row gap 1
  each options workout.kind
    button "+" it tap add workout kind = it
describe:
Workouts, in the plum colours.
Keeps:
- workout: kind: one of Run, Gym, Yoga, Walk, starts at Run. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Remembers while you use it: m, starting at today.
Shows:
- arrows that move m back and forward one month.
- a grid of 7 columns:
  - for "M", "T", "W", "T", "F", "S", "S":
    - text: the value.
  - for each number from 1 to the weekday number of m minus the day of the month of m plus 1 minus 1:
  - for each day in the month of m:
    - text: the day of the month of the day.
    - for each workout on the day:
      - a drawing made of circles.
- for each choice of the kind of the workout:
  - a button "+", the choice; a tap adds a workout with kind set to the choice.

program:
app "Beads" beads plum
table zikr
setting target num = 33 "Beads in a round"
let n = count(zikr today)
draw 100, 100 width 260 tap add zikr
  each 1..target as i
    circle 50 + 40 * sin(360 * i / target), 50 - 40 * cos(360 * i / target), 3 fill if(i <= n % target, accent, soft)
  label 50, 48, n % target big
  label 50, 62, "Round" floor(n / target) + 1 faint
"Total today" n faint
describe:
Beads, in the plum colours.
Keeps:
- zikr: just the time of each entry. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
You can change: "Beads in a round": number, starts at 33.
Works out:
- n is how many zikr entries today.
Shows:
- a drawing made of circles, labels; a tap adds a zikr.
- text: "Total today", n.
hurried_style: lowercase with one or two typos, 3 to 10 words
fuller_style: one long sentence of 18 to 30 words
order: start with who it is for

program:
app "Canteen" cart mint
table sale item pick Samosa|Juice|Biscuit|Sandwich|Fries = Samosa, price money
setting rs money = 30 "Price of each"
"Total today" sum(sale.price today) big
grid 3 gap 1
  each options sale.item as o
    stack card gap 0 align center tap add sale item = o, price = rs
      o bold
      count(sale today where item = o) big
button "Undo last" tap remove last(sale today)
describe:
Canteen, in the mint colours.
Keeps:
- sale: item: one of Samosa, Juice, Biscuit, Sandwich, Fries, starts at Samosa; price: money. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
You can change: "Price of each": money, starts at 30.
Shows:
- text: "Total today", the total price of sale today.
- a grid of 3 columns:
  - for each choice of the item of the sale:
    - a group; a tap adds a sale with item set to the choice, price set to rs:
      - text: the choice.
      - text: how many sale entries today where item is the choice.
- a button "Undo last"; a tap removes the latest sale entries today, with undo.

program:
app "Garden log" plant ocean
table dig bed text, task pick Sow|Water|Weed|Harvest|Other = Water, note text?
screen main "Add" plus
  stat count(dig month), "this month"
  stat since(dig), "days since the last entry"
  form dig
screen charts "Charts" chart
  daybars last 7 days, count(dig on it)
  list dig by day
remind "Time to add garden" at 8:00, 20:00
describe:
Garden log, in the ocean colours.
Keeps:
- dig: bed: text; task: one of Sow, Water, Weed, Harvest, Other, starts at Water; note: text, optional. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Shows:
- a screen "Add":
  - a big number: how many dig entries this month, labelled "this month".
  - a big number: days since the last of dig entries, labelled "days since the last entry".
  - a form to add a dig.
- a screen "Charts":
  - a bar chart of how many dig entries on that day for each day in the last 7 days.
  - a list of dig by day; tap one to edit it, swipe to remove it.
Reminder "Time to add garden" at 8:00, 20:00 every day.

program:
app "Library books" book mint
table loan title text, return_on date, returned bool
remind "Return the book" at loan.return_on
count(loan where returned = no) "open" head
each loan where returned = no sort return_on as r
  row card gap 2 tap edit r swipe remove r
    toggle r.returned
    stack grow
      r.title bold
      r.return_on small color if(r.return_on < today, bad, muted)
form loan
"Done" faint
list loan where returned = yes
describe:
Library books, in the mint colours.
Keeps:
- loan: title: text; return on: date; returned: yes or no. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Shows:
- text: how many loan entries where returned is no, "open".
- for each loan where returned is no sorted by return on:
  - a group; a tap opens the loan for editing; a swipe removes the loan, with undo:
    - a tick box for the returned of the loan.
    - text: the title of the loan.
    - text: the return on of the loan.
- a form to add a loan.
- text: "Done".
- a list of loan where returned is yes; tap one to edit it, swipe to remove it.
Reminder "Return the book" on each return on of the loan entries.

program:
app "Spare parts" tool ocean
table part name text, qty num 0.., low num 0.. = 3, price money?, expires date?
let short = count(part, it.qty <= it.low)
short "parts running low" head color if(short > 0, warn, good)
each part sort qty as i
  row card gap 1 tap edit i swipe remove i
    stack grow
      i.name bold color if(i.qty <= i.low, warn, ink)
      "Expires" i.expires faint color if(i.expires < today, bad, muted)
    button "-" tap set i.qty = i.qty - 1
    i.qty bold
    button "+" tap set i.qty = i.qty + 1
"Stock value" sum(part, it.qty * it.price) faint
form part
remind "Check your parts" at 9:00 on sat
describe:
Spare parts, in the ocean colours.
Keeps:
- part: name: text; qty: number, at least 0; low: number, at least 0, starts at 3; price: money, optional; expires: date, optional. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Works out:
- short is how many of the part have its qty is at most its low.
Shows:
- text: short, "parts running low".
- for each part sorted by qty:
  - a group; a tap opens the part for editing; a swipe removes the part, with undo:
    - text: the name of the part.
    - text: "Expires", the expires of the part.
    - a button "-"; a tap sets the qty of the part to the qty of the part minus 1.
    - text: the qty of the part.
    - a button "+"; a tap sets the qty of the part to the qty of the part plus 1.
- text: "Stock value", the sum of its qty times its price over the part.
- a form to add a part.
Reminder "Check your parts" at 9:00 on Sat.
hurried_style: all lowercase, no punctuation, 2 to 8 words
fuller_style: one long sentence of 18 to 30 words
order: mention the last feature first
